title: Which micro-batch brought each view
prompt: The product team wants to know which micro-batch delivered each product page view. Write `solve(page_views)` so it streams the delivery files and returns `micro_batch`, `event_id` and `session_id` for every product page view.
rules: Each delivery file is its own micro-batch, read in order.
`micro_batch` is the id Spark gives the micro-batch, starting at 0. It isn't the `batch` column: delivery numbers can skip.
Keep only rows whose `page_type` is `product`, and return these three columns.
hints: Read the folder with `spark.readStream`, the table's schema and `option("maxFilesPerTrigger", 1)`.
`foreachBatch(fn)` calls `fn(batch_df, batch_id)` once per micro-batch; `batch_df.collect()` gives that micro-batch's rows.
Start with `trigger(availableNow=True)` and wait with `awaitTermination()` before building the DataFrame from `rows`.
